releaseNotes: Text blocks now grow horizontally to the right while typing until the available page width is reached
After reaching the available width, text wraps and the block continues to grow vertically
Automatic growth always respects the right and bottom page boundaries
The large E-Ink friendly manual resize handle remains available for deliberate resizing
The persistent LuMa text-options panel and non-clipping Pen/Marker display remain enabled
Text content, formatting, size and position remain persisted across tool changes and reloads
No new APK is required; Shell 1.1.0 remains sufficient
